name: pedestrian_diffusion
notes: Parameter-bearing submodules of utils/mmodules/PedestrianDiffusion.py (config.json defaults) rebuilt on CPU with diffusers==0.36.0 (version pinned in envsetup.sh's commented list): special_loss.log_vars (2x5, spectrumMultiTaskLoss), VAE = utils/mmodels/VAE3D.py VAE3D_1024(latent_dim=512, in_channels=6) with deleteDecoder() and requires_grad=False, model = diffusers UNet3DConditionModel(sample_size=(4,4), in_channels=24, out_channels=12, 2x CrossAttnDown/Up3D, block_out_channels=[128,256], layers_per_block=1, cross_attention_dim=512, attention_head_dim=64). The Lightning module itself was not imported (it needs deepspeed, torchmetrics, CLIP download, etc.); spectrumMultiTaskLoss was replaced by a stand-in holding the same single parameter in the same registration position. Metric modules and processors have no parameters. trainable_params excludes the frozen VAE encoder, matching the official requires_grad flags. Input to the IPB model is (B,6,200)@200Hz; the port decimates to 100 Hz and computes the STFT (n_fft=30, hop=14, hann, center=True, pad_mode=constant) -> (B,6,16,8,2); the CLIP text tokens (77x512) come from a frozen openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 text encoder that is NOT counted here.

official_config.description: config.json: RoNINs/hybrid, sampling_rate=100 Hz, window_size=100 (1 s), stride=33, n_fft=30, hop=14, latent_dim=512, num_time_steps=1000, target_time_steps=1, DPMSolverMultistep (squaredcos_cap_v2, zero-SNR rescale, prediction_type=sample)

benchmark_config.description: IPB window=200 @ 200 Hz -> internal anti-aliased decimation x2 -> 100 samples @ 100 Hz -> identical network; architecture unchanged (VAE3D kernel=(16,8,2) hard-codes 16 bins x 8 frames).
